title: LOGAN — Rig-to-Render VFX Breakdown (V6.2 Hollywood IMAX)

shots.description: Medium-close 85mm portrait in Maya/MetaHuman clay viewport with 3D NURBS torso/arm/finger controller splines and live golden facial rig picker GUI; right hand rises across chest, fans open, and clenches into a fist as acoustic vacuum drops.

Hard match-cut on SNIKT! eruption: 3 curved hollow-ground Adamantium claws shoot from inter-knuckle valleys in dark obsidian Rembrandt chiaroscuro lighting, weathered blood-stained workshirt, skin pores, and metallic sparks.
Extreme 100mm macro clay viewport on clenched right fist with orange FK phalanx splines, 3 satin-white curved claws sweeping diagonally up-right, and golden rig-logic picker schematic behind.
Hard match-cut to hyper-real macro render: bruised weathered knuckles, dermal subsurface blood warmth, wet skin pores, and anisotropic brushed-steel Adamantium bevels catching a cold cyan rim glint.
Intimate 3/4 portrait clay sculpt with groomed beard/brows, red sagittal centerline spline, yellow neck ring, and live ARKit brow-furrow, squint, sneer, and eye-saccade micro-acting.
Hard match-cut to 3/4 final render: raking 3800K warm Rembrandt key light across forehead wrinkles, temple sweat sheen, bruised brow ridge, thick beard strands, and wet corneal catchlight.
Dead-center portrait clay rig with chin pitched down, eyes locked upward beneath furrowed brows, yellow collar controller ring, and red vertical symmetry spline.
Protected pure-cinema climax match-cut on Dolby sub-drop: fierce dead-center Logan Kubrick stare with dual wet eye catchlights, subtle jaw clench, heavy breath, and cold steel-cyan rim halo.
Match-cut back to medium-close clay viewport as claws sheath and right arm settles smoothly into exact Frame 0 rest state for seamless infinite Reel/Short looping.
